results.text: You have 2 main players, they did a kind of price war for years and years and years. [#3074](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3074)
So we could imagine to merge 2 companies and make to the acquisition, but the antitrust authorities in Australia are quite rigid. [#3075](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3075)
And for instance, some private equity tried to do this merger in the past, but it has been canceled 2x by the antitrust authority. [#3076](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3076)
So that's why we consider that it's probably not a market for us. [#3077](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3077)
And of course, to finish and to conclude the biggest market of the world. [#3079](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3079)
So North America. [#3080](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3080)
So you know that we took some initiative last year. [#3081](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3081)
to try to enter in North America. [#3082](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3082)
We regularly launch some market study. [#3083](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3083)
It is the biggest market of the world as a second player of the world in this industry. [#3084](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3084)
Of course, it is our job to have some regular study on what happened in North America. [#3085](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3085)
The situation is not simple for Elis. [#3086](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3086)
Because you have 2 different situations in uniform and flatline as you know. [#3087](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3087)
So if we start with uniform. [#3088](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3088)
So uniform as of today, the market that presents a better level of margin. [#3089](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3089)
But it is a super consolidated market. [#3090](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3090)
So if you take the 3 leaders, so Cintas, Vestis and UniFirst, they have more or less [ 2/3 ] of the market. [#3091](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3091)
So that means that why not considering an entry regional player. [#3092](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3092)
So it could make sense, but it is impossible for us. [#3093](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3093)
Let's be clear on that. [#3094](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3094)

We will never be the company that is able to offer the best right for a family for a regional player because for a regional player, antitrust would not be an issue for the 2 or 3 giant. [#3095](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3095)

And of course, when you see the level of synergies that could expect UniFirst or Cintas, of course, they could pay a much higher price than Elis. [#3096](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3096)

So that's why I think that we have absolutely no chance to find any kind of opportunity with any regional player because we'll be always with competition in price that we cannot sustain. [#3097](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3097)
So it remains the 2 big options that we studied last year  -- so let's took 2 minutes to analyze the situation. [#3099](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3099)
For UniFirst, I think that it's also impossible now for us. [#3100](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3100)
because we were more or less believing that Cintas would not take the risk of antitrust to try to make an offer on UniFirst. [#3101](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3101)
But we have seen last December, that they were ready to take the risk of antitrust. [#3102](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3102)
And you know that Cintas made a kind of a hostile approach to try to buy UniFirst. [#3103](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3103)

And of course, they have a level of synergy that means that a cash offer of Elis has no chance to be successful with UniFirst because, of course, Cintas can pay significantly more than what we can offer. [#3104](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3104)
So that's why we consider that the deal in full in cash as we were working on is a debt for us. [#3105](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3105)
Vestis, so Vestis, you have followed the story of Vests. [#3107](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3107)

I think that the evolution of the financial performance, but even the operational performance in every day worse and worse and worse. [#3108](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3108)
So nobody can predict really where they will be in 1 quarter or in 1 semester. [#3109](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3109)
So it's not at all an option for Elis. [#3110](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3110)
And even, by the way, because we had some question regarding the share price evolution of Vestis. [#3111](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3111)
So is it now more an option for a lease at $6. [#3112](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3112)
But let's be serious as the evolution of the EBIT has been quite dramatical over the last quarter. [#3113](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3113)

That means that for us, even at $6, it is a super expensive deal because when you take just the evolution of the EBIT and what you can expect for the year '26, for instance, in terms of multiple, even at $6, it is by far too expensive for such an asset with such a level of difficulty. [#3114](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3114)
So it's not an option for Elis. [#3115](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3115)
Flatline now, why not? [#3117](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3117)
So we have also some contacts in Flatline finance in hospitality and health care. [#3118](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3118)
The market is much more fragmented today, but we start to see a kind of consolidation under the pressure of some private equity. [#3119](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3119)

It is something that is a concern for us because private equity, it is our feeling today are paying too much for such quality of assets. [#3120](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3120)
And so the multiple paid by private equity tin flatline in U.S. are too expensive. [#3121](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3121)
And so it is not at all a good moment to imagine an entry point for a lease in flatline. [#3122](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3122)

The quality of the asset and the quality of the performance, the financial performance of companies that we have studied, does not justify the multiples that property are ready to pay today in the U.S. market for flatline. [#3123](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3123)
So to summarize, North America Fortis is not for tomorrow. [#3124](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3124)

So now we have covered what could come next, and it's time to have a more financial view and to see with figures, what are the consequence of all the initiatives that we have presented today, and I will give the floor to Louis. [#3126](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3126)
Thank you, Xavier. [#3128](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3128)
Good afternoon, everybody. [#3129](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3129)
Long day, not long now. [#3130](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3130)
I will just wrap up basically what we have said today and I guess that you will recognize most of the figures. [#3131](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3131)
First, we like to begin with this chart that we are very proud about. [#3132](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3132)
Of course, it's 25 years history of Elis revenue in -- on EBITDA margin. [#3133](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3133)

What you can see is that basically, the stand-alone business is a regular growth, very regular, a part of course -- and which we had time to time, some structural deal like we had in '14, '16, '17, more so '22. [#3134](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3134)

And that's the story of Elis of growing company, much more diversified as you are aware of, if you look at year '21, barely EUR 600 and 20% range and now nearly EUR 5 billion company, 30% French only. [#3136](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3136)
The EBITDA margin makes us very proud, of course, because very high level in a narrow range. [#3137](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3137)
And what you see is that where we are in a stand-alone story, we improved the margin continuously. [#3138](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3138)
We underlined 3 crisis, we could have put more, but there was the Internet bubble, there was a pond. [#3140](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3140)
It was energy crisis, there was inflation. [#3141](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3141)
There was a lot of bad stories recently and over, of course, the last century. [#3142](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3142)
Every time Elis has demonstrated that the model was super resilient and was able to resist to whatever. [#3143](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3143)

It's even more impressive when you look at cash flow because in the cash flow, you have the CapEx in the working capital who comes hand in hand with the revenue. [#3144](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3144)
So take year '20, for example, in year '20, we have been able to keep the -- CapEx. [#3145](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3145)

Working capital has been very good and so the free cash flow in the year '20 was better than in the year '19 -- lot of people have been able to do that. [#3146](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3146)
So we are super proud, of course, of this achievement. [#3147](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3147)
If you look at the shorter period, let's say, 5 last year, the movement is also supply impressive. [#3149](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3149)
Let's look at the main KPIs. [#3150](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3150)
So the revenue, nearly 30% growth over the last 5 years. [#3151](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3151)
The EBITDA margin, 1.6%; EBITDA 2.1%. [#3152](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3152)
Now you look at the EPS, 60% nearly, the ROCE plus 5 points, nearly reaching 15% and the free cash flow doubled. [#3153](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3153)
At the same time, we have lowered the leverage from about 3x to below 2x. [#3154](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3154)
You remember, it was a kind of concern of the market after '18 when the interest rate began to rise. [#3155](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3155)
And we said, okay, let's hear what the markets to say. [#3156](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3156)
We probably will be more comfortable below 2x and being investment grade. [#3157](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3157)
It is done. [#3158](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3158)

And it has never jeopardized as you can see, the profitable both which is my guess, the key word when you look at the chart, profitable growth is what Elis is going to deliver. [#3159](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3159)
To import KPIs we look at or EPS on ROCE. [#3161](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3161)
Why? [#3162](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3162)
Because they totally represent the value creation. [#3163](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3163)
EPS is value creation for the shareholders, and we are fully aware because the EPS kind of stands for the value of the share. [#3164](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3164)
And the -- is ROCE because it's a asset value creation of the company, how much value we take out of the capital invested. [#3165](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3165)
We compare the year '24 with the year '18. [#3166](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3166)
Why '18? [#3167](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3167)
Because if you have the story right, it's the first year of stabilization after the big deals in [ Dusal, Lavebras, Berendsen ]. [#3168](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3168)

So that's when I would say, the market was looking for us saying, okay, the 3 major acquisitions in role, a lot of new countries, double the size, what they will do with the stuff. [#3169](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3169)

And well, we have done that, meaning that the EPS has grown by 80%, 80%, so demonstration of our ability to integrate and value and turn around this business, but it's no surprise. [#3170](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3170)
Over the gentlemen, [ Marc Franklin ] in the U.K., [ Octavio Carvallo ] in Brazil. [#3171](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3171)
We could have done the same with Spain. [#3172](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3172)
And the ROCE, of course, was paralleling in the same time from 9% to 14.5%. [#3173](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3173)

That is an absolute demonstration of our quality of integration, meaning that the capital invested into the business have delivered accordingly to the expectation. [#3174](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3174)

What perhaps on ROCE because we have a lot of questions that -- so that's the moment where I will shift and put my cascade of content. [#3176](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3176)
The way we calculate the ROCE -- forward basically. [#3177](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3177)
We take the EBITDA, which is EUR 733 million last year. [#3178](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3178)
Why EBITDA? [#3179](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3179)
Because in the -- you've got amortization of intangible, which is totally subjective. [#3180](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3180)
When we do an acquisition, we could put all the overvalue into goodwill, never depreciated, and it will be exactly the same amount. [#3181](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3181)
So that's why we take EBITDA, which is a fair point. [#3182](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3182)
As for the capital employed, it's also pretty straightforward. [#3183](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3183)
It's the capital we have invested into the business and which is supposed to give value. [#3184](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3184)
So what is the capital invested. [#3185](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3185)
It's the net asset minus the nonfinancial liabilities. [#3186](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3186)

When you look at the balance sheet of Elis, there's one technical point is that we have merged a long time ago with a holding company of the last private equity. [#3187](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3187)
So we have the kind of artificial goodwill and net asset, by the way, of EUR 1.5 billion linked to this merger. [#3188](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3188)
But is -- has never been invested in Elis. [#3189](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3189)
It's fair to underline that it shall not be a value. [#3190](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3190)
So that's basically the way we calculate. [#3191](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3191)
We can discuss -- about that on that, but globally, that's the point. [#3192](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3192)

Now looking at the valuation, it's fair to say that the markets have not given us full credit of the fantastic June that we had since and Bloomberg view of the multiple of EBIT that you can see on the screens. [#3194](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3194)
So we stand at around 11x, Bloomberg is a bit higher because they take a big, big bet for Elis, I don't know why. [#3195](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3195)
But globally, circa 11x, which you can compare with first -- 2 guys in Orange, which are vested under Johnson. [#3196](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3196)

No offense, but we truly believe that we kind of overperformed the gentlemen, 4x below UniFirst, which, by the way, is here also a bit unfair -- at the organic growth and the EBIT margins of the companies, of the 2 companies, even if we have the highest respect as you know, for UniFirst, fantastic company. [#3197](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3197)
I don't even mention Cintas because you begin to wonder whether we are speaking of the same KPI. [#3198](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3198)

You can also compare the historics that of Elis because when you look backwards, we are trading 4x below the historical multiples even if we have -- you have seen that we developed a very profitable company, and we have a much better profile today. [#3199](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3199)
What isn't done. [#3200](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3200)
Let's look for the future. [#3201](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3201)
So the future, what shall we expect now in the coming years? [#3203](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3203)
I think that you come out of this day, convinced of 2 things. [#3204](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3204)
First, our ability of delivering regular organic growth and send our ability of a bolt-on acquisition. [#3205](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3205)

So that's why we consider that in the future, we shall be able to deliver to 5% to 6% growth for the stand-alone business model, a stand-alone is, by definition, without major acquisitions like recently Mexico before that salary was. [#3206](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3206)
Regardless also ForEx, by definition within the -- white gas. [#3207](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3207)
On this 5% to 6% total growth, 4% organic. [#3208](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3208)
And so I guess that you get convinced that we have the opportunities, we have the commercial organization. [#3209](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3209)

We put the effort in all the geographies, and we have the diversification of the geographies that allows us to deliver this growth as demonstrated on the recent years. [#3210](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3210)
I think you give credit to mature to find this by -- ship or integrate them. [#3212](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3212)
That's the second part of the growth, coming from the [ Burton ], we have a pipeline, and we like to deliver it. [#3213](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3213)

The second KPI to look at, of course, is EBITDA margin, that also when you -- air Frederic speaking about productivity, but also when you were Elis speaking about pricing power, when you know that the additional volumes comes with splendid and looking at the chart, I think, are convinced that a 20 bps improvement in the coming years in average is absolutely doable. [#3214](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3214)

Another way to look at it, by the way, is that we have a lot of countries that are mature enough to deliver 40% circa EBITDA margin. [#3216](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3216)
But it's not only France. [#3217](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3217)
It's also Netherlands, it's Poland, it's [ Baltic check ]. [#3218](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3218)
It is Portugal, it's Mexico. [#3219](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3219)
So we have a club of the 40%. [#3220](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3220)
And all the other countries, and you have seen the energy of the -- and these are, of course, willing to join the club. [#3221](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3221)
So 20 bps improvement in average. [#3222](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3222)
Of course, all that dropped into the free cash flow. [#3224](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3224)
In the last 4 years, we delivered EUR 1.1 billion. [#3225](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3225)
When you do the math, as I'm sure you are doing exactly now, I'm looking at Ben. [#3226](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3226)
You will find like me, EUR 1.5 billion in the next 4 years, which is exactly 35% above what we did in the last fall. [#3227](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3227)
At the end of the day, to wrap up 5.5% to 6% growth -- total growth, of which 4% organic. [#3229](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3229)
EBITDA improving by 20 bps in average, it means that EBITDA, EBIT EPS shall grow faster than top line. [#3230](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3230)
Again, you do the math, it works. [#3231](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3231)
Free cash flow, 35% more in the next 4 years than in the last 4 years. [#3232](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3232)
So with this free cash flow, what will we do? [#3234](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3234)
I think we gave the answer already in March. [#3235](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3235)
We have this new capital allocation policy. [#3236](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3236)
